speaker: Ms Irene Quay Siew Ching
text: asked the Minister for Health (a) how rigorous is medication tested by the Health Sciences Authority before the drugs enter Singapore; (b) whether the testing is in line with international testing standards; (c) whether there are public concerns with generic use of medications in Singapore; and (d) what are the steps and considerations taken by the Ministry compared to other countries' handling of the same worldwide concern, particularly with the Losartan recall.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
text: HSA conducts in-depth technical assessments of the scientific data from clinical studies, as well as the manufacturing and quality control processes.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
text: In addition, HSA checks that the manufacturers conform to international standards of Good Manufacturing Practice.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
text: After approval, HSA conducts post-market surveillance which includes monitoring of global developments and risk-based product sampling and testing for compliance to quality and safety specifications.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Products found to be deficient in quality will be withdrawn from the market.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Manufacturers are also required to test all batches of medicines to be sold in Singapore, including the levels of specific impurities, to ensure that they comply with stipulated standards.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Generic medicines are subject to the same strict regime of regulatory controls to ensure their safety, efficacy and quality.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
text: The standards, checks and processes adopted by HSA are similar to those adopted by regulatory counterparts in other jurisdictions, such as Australia, Canada, Europe, Japan and the United States (US).

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
text: HSA’s Pharmaceutical Laboratory is also accredited to international standards, such as the International Organization for Standardization/International Electrotechnical Commission 17025 standard for testing laboratories.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
text: It is also a World Health Organization Collaborating Centre for Medicines Quality Assurance.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
text: The routine tests required of the manufacturers are based on known impurities that may be generated during the manufacturing process, as it is not practical to exhaustively test for all types of impurities.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
text: In the case of the recalled losartan medicines, testing for nitrosamines like NMBA was not previously part of the testing parameters of ARB medicines as NMBA was not expected to be generated in the manufacturing process.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
text: This approach is similar to that adopted in other countries, including the US, Canada and the European Union.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Sudden stopping of their medication could pose greater and more immediate risk to patients’ health.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Meanwhile, HSA and our public healthcare family worked together to reach out to affected patients to facilitate a switch to alternative medicines.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
text: HSA tested all locally marketed ARB medicines to ensure that these alternatives do not contain NMBA.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Public healthcare institutions then scheduled appointments for affected patients to switch to alternative medicines.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
text: The institutions also deployed additional staff to operate the hotlines for patient queries and set up service touchpoints to help patients switch their medicines.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
text: These actions went beyond what most other countries had done.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Since the recall, HSA has also been working with suppliers and international regulatory agencies to determine the cause of contamination, and to formulate measures to eliminate the nitrosamines in the medium to longer term.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
text: HSA will continue to monitor the quality and safety of these medicines to safeguard public health.

speaker: Ms Irene Quay Siew Ching (Nominated Member)
text: I think this is something the world can learn from us.

speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
text: This is based on the current concept of operation whereby affected patients will be restricted to only one-month supply, and gradually increasing to two or even three months of supply, which is the regular practice, from 1 July onwards.

speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
text: We would like to reassure all patients that we have sufficient stocks of alternatives, as well as losartan stocks that are not contaminated with the nitrosamines.

speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
text: Things should go back to normalcy from July onwards.
